title: Could not find a production build
text_content:
## Why This Error Occurred

When running `next start` or a custom server in production mode a production build is needed.

## Possible Ways to Fix It

- Run `next build` to create a production build before booting up the production server.
- If your intention was to run the development server run `next dev` instead.

title: Public `_next` folder Conflict
text_content:
## Why This Error Occurred

In your `./public` folder you added a `_next` folder which conflicts with the internal usage of `_next`. Due to this conflicting this folder name is not allowed inside of your `public` folder.

## Possible Ways to Fix It

Rename the `_next` folder in your `public` folder to something else or remove it.
